title: Young Adult Drinking Fell To 50% Instead Of Rising
hook: Only 50% of young adults now say they drink alcohol.
closing: Drinking is no longer the default for young adults, changing what social pressure around alcohol looks like.
question: Is drinking less becoming normal?

segments.say: Young-adult drinking fell to 50%, making abstaining just as common as drinking in this group.
Among the youngest adults, drinking fell to 35%, showing the retreat is even sharper at the bottom of the age range.
Weekly drinking among young drinkers is 61%, showing the shift includes frequency, not just whether they drink at all.
